def: of a joint body, i.e. (figuratively) a fellow-member of the Christian community

occurrences.text: That the Gentiles should be fellowheirs, and of the same body, and partakers of his promise in Christ by the gospel:

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
